lines: Imagine falling from the sky through a violent storm and waking up alone in a deadly jungle.
On 24 December 1971 a passenger plane is struck by lightning and breaks apart midair.
Seventeen year old Juliane Koepcke falls about 3000 meters while still strapped to her seat row.
She wakes up on the dark forest floor with a broken collarbone and a deep arm cut.
She also suffers from a painful eye injury and a severe concussion after the terrifying plunge.
Her biologist father previously taught her that following flowing water always leads back to people.
She finds a tiny creek and begins walking through the dense and dangerous Peruvian rainforest.
Days pass slowly as she follows the winding water toward a larger and safer river.
Up to 14 other passengers survive the initial crash but tragically die before any rescue arrives.
She spends 11 long days completely alone in the unforgiving jungle facing unimaginable odds.
After 9 days of difficult travel she finally discovers a remote lumberjack camp by the river.
She is found by local workers who provide medical help and bring her back to safety.
Juliane remains the only official survivor of LANSA Flight 508 against all odds and expectations.
Would you have the mental strength to survive 11 days alone in the dangerous rainforest?
draft_evening.title: The Girl Who Fell 3000 Meters And Survived

lines: If a hurricane approaches your beach, do not worry about howling wind first.
Water from storm surge causes most hurricane deaths, and Jake has 10 minutes left.
Panicked crowds scramble off the sand as dark dusk skies unleash ferocious breaking swells.
One. If officials say evacuate, go immediately because rising surge drowns entire coastal zones.
Jake remembers the golden rule to run from water and hide from wind.
He chooses to walk to shelter toward a massive 10-floor concrete hotel nearby.
Two. Leave dangerous surge zones fast and seek shelter inside a sturdy reinforced building.
Jake hurries across the empty lobby and moves upstairs away from the ground.
Three. Stay far away from exterior windows and lock yourself inside an interior room.
He enters an interior hallway room with thick walls and closes the heavy door.
Outside, the violent ocean surge slams onto the beach and swallows the lower floors.
Steel reinforced concrete holds firm against the punishing waves crashing below his high sanctuary.
Down below, exploding transformers illuminate the dark sky and power lines plunge into water.
He followed every single evacuation rule, securing himself safely above the raging ocean flood.
It was the perfect plan, but there was suddenly just one terrifying new problem.
Black water begins gushing through the hallway floor vents as live electrical wires spark.
part1.cliffhanger: Surge water is flooding up into Jake's safe interior hallway while downed, sparking electrical power lines threaten to electrify the water.
